narrative: 一列黑色的剪影行列：一位骑手、一棵树、一座宫殿，各自处于自己的平面上。当场景应当被解读为用卡纸剪出的戏剧，而不是一个带补光的立体房间时使用它。
对于一个在真实场地中被逆光照亮的单一人物，或者一个依然带有绘制面孔的微缩模型来说，这就用错了工具。如果只有一层黑色平面，你拍的是剪影。
如果模型是完全穿戴打扮、按比例搭建的，你拍的是微缩模型（Diorama）。
how: 把人物和建筑分别剪裁成独立的图层，在一个强光源前把它们在纵深方向上错开排布。
面部不加补光，边缘保持图形化。
如果摄影机缓慢移动，各图层之间要产生视差，光源在后方。
摄影机在前方。如果有颜色，那也是在背光或几个染色平面上，而不是在有立体质感的皮肤上。
提示词：a shadow-box of the subject: layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness。
when: 用在应当让人感觉像一出用纸剪出的夜戏的那个段落。当脸部必须承载皮肤质感和眼神光时，不要使用它。
vs: 剪影（Silhouette）是一个逆光照亮的人物，通常处于真实空间中；影箱剪纸则是把许多剪影层层叠加。
微缩模型（Diorama）是一个带有立体质感的微缩世界；影箱剪纸则是层层叠加的黑色剪影，而不是一个带补光的微缩布景。
examples_film: 《阿基米德王子历险记》（The Adventures of Prince Achmed）是把剪影动画作为层叠戏剧来使用；卡拉·沃克（Kara Walker）的剪影行列语言，是静态艺术和装置艺术领域的表亲。
这是层叠黑影的语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是单独的剪影，以及打了光的微缩模型。破绽是出现了皮肤质感，或者只有一层黑色平面。
解决办法是层叠的剪影、身后的强光源，以及不加补光的人物。

faq.q: 电影中的影箱剪纸是什么？
faq.a: 影箱剪纸用层叠的剪影讲述故事。纵深由层层叠加的剪影构成，就像一个黑暗中的微缩模型，而不是一个带补光的写实空间。

faq.q: 影箱剪纸 vs 剪影
faq.a: 剪影通常是一个被逆光照亮的人物；影箱剪纸则是许多层叠在纵深方向上的剪影平面。一个是一个人物，另一个是纸质剧场。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用影箱剪纸？
faq.a: 当场景应当被解读为层叠的黑影时使用它：一列行进队伍、一则寓言，一个用卡纸剪出的夜晚。当脸部需要皮肤质感和主光时，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写影箱剪纸的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Shadow-box of [Subject], layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes"。要求呈现多个平面、一个强烈的背光，以及不加补光的人物。

narrative: A procession of blacks: a rider, a tree, a palace, each on its own plane. Use it when the scene should be read as theatre cut from card, not as a modeled room with fill.
It is the wrong tool for a single backlit person in a real location, and for a miniature that still has painted faces. If there is only one plane of black, you shot a silhouette.
If the model is fully dressed and scaled, you shot a diorama.
how: Cut figures and architecture as separate layers. Space them in depth in front of a hard source.
No fill on the faces. Edges stay graphic.
Parallax between layers if the camera creeps. The source is behind.
The camera is in front. Color, if any, is in the backlight or in a few tinted planes, not in modeled skin.
Prompt a shadow-box of the subject: layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness.
when: Use it for the beat that should feel like a night play made of paper. Do not use it when the face must carry skin and eye light.
vs: Silhouette is one backlit figure, usually in real space. A shadow box stacks many cut-outs.
Diorama is a miniature world with modeled volume. A shadow box is layers of black, not a tiny set with fill.
examples_film: The Adventures of Prince Achmed is silhouette animation as stacked theatre. Kara Walker's language of cut-out processions is the still and installation cousin.
Grammar of layered black, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousins are a lone Silhouette and a lit Diorama. The tell is skin texture, or only one black plane.
The fix is stacked cut-outs, hard source behind, unfilled figures.

faq.q: What is a shadow box in film?
faq.a: A shadow box tells the story in layered cut-outs. Depth is stacked silhouettes, like a diorama of darkness, not a filled naturalistic space.
A silhouette is usually one backlit body. A shadow box is many cut-out planes stacked in depth. One is a figure. The other is paper theatre.

faq.q: When should I use a shadow box?
faq.a: Use it when the scene should be read as stacked blacks: a procession, a fable, a night cut from card. Skip it when the face needs skin and a key.

faq.q: How do I prompt a shadow box for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Shadow-box of [Subject], layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes. Demand several planes, a hard backlight, and unfilled figures.
